arxiv-1904-11092.title: Numerical Algorithm for Detecting Ion Diffusion Regions in the Geomagnetic Tail with Applications to MMS Tail Season May 1– September 30, 2017 Thanks: UNH, NH
arxiv-1904-11092.description: A 2019 arXiv research paper by . We present a numerical algorithm aimed at identifying ion diffusion regions (IDRs) in the geomagnetic tail, and test its applicability. We use 5 criteria applied in three stages. (i) Correlated reversals (within 90 s) of V x and B z (at least 2 nT about zero; GSM coordinates); (ii) Detection of Hall electric and magnetic field signatures; and (iii) strong ( ≥ 10 ​ m ​ V / m \geq 10mV/m ) electric fields.

arxiv-2103-12176.title: New Perspectives on Centering
arxiv-2103-12176.creator: Jack B. Protherolabel=e1]jackb37@live.unc.edu, Jan Hanniglabel=e2]jan.hannig@unc.edu, J.S. Marronlabel=e3]MARRON@unc.edu
arxiv-2103-12176.description: Abstract Data matrix centering is an ever-present yet under-examined aspect of data analysis. Functional data analysis (FDA) often operates with a default of centering such that the vectors in one dimension have mean zero. We find that centering along the other dimension identifies a novel useful mode of variation beyond those familiar in FDA.

arxiv-2205-07922.title: Dark lenses through the dust: parallax microlensing events in the VVV 2022 Dark lenses through the dust: parallax microlensing events in the VVV – 4
arxiv-2205-07922.creator: Zofia Kaczmarek, Peter McGill, N. Wyn Evans, Leigh C. Smith, Łukasz Wyrzykowski, Kornel Howil, Maja Jabłońska
arxiv-2205-07922.description: Abstract We use near-infrared photometry and astrometry from the VISTA Variables in the Via Lactea (VVV) survey to analyse microlensing events containing annual microlensing parallax information. These events are located in highly extincted and low-latitude regions of the Galactic bulge typically off-limits to optical microlensing surveys.

arxiv-2208-10138.title: Learning Correlated Equilibria in Mean-Field Games
arxiv-2208-10138.creator: Paul Muller, Romuald Elie, Mark Rowland, Mathieu Lauriere, Julien Perolat, Sarah Perrin, Matthieu Geist, Georgios Piliouras, Olivier Pietquin, Karl Tuyls
arxiv-2208-10138.description: Abstract The designs of many large-scale systems today, from traffic routing environments to smart grids, rely on game-theoretic equilibrium concepts. However, as the size of an N N -player game typically grows exponentially with N N , standard game theoretic analysis becomes effectively infeasible beyond a low number of players.

arxiv-2208-11630.title: Flash-X, a multiphysics simulation software instrument Journal: SoftwareX
arxiv-2208-11630.creator: A. Dubey, K. Weide, J. O’Neal, A. Dhruv, S. Couch, J.A. Harris, T. Klosterman, R. Jain, J. Rudi, O.E.B. Messer, M. Pajkos, J. Carlson, R. Chu, M. Wahib, S. Chawdhary, P.M. Ricker, D. Lee, K. Antypas, K.M. Riley, C. Daley, M. Ganapathy, F.X. Timmes, D.M. Townsley, M. Vanella, J. Bachan, P.Rich, S. Ku
arxiv-2208-11630.description: Abstract Flash-X is a highly composable multiphysics software system that can be used to simulate physical phenomena in several scientific domains. It derives some of its solvers from FLASH, which was first released in 2000. Flash-X has a new framework that relies on abstractions and asynchronous communications for performance portability across a range of increasingly heterogeneous hardware platforms.

arxiv-2307-08771.title: UPSCALE: Unconstrained Channel Pruning
arxiv-2307-08771.creator: Alvin Wan, Hanxiang Hao, Kaushik Patnaik, Yueyang Xu, Omer Hadad, David Güera, Zhile Ren, Qi Shan
arxiv-2307-08771.description: Abstract As neural networks grow in size and complexity, inference speeds decline. To combat this, one of the most effective compression techniques – channel pruning – removes channels from weights. However, for multi-branch segments of a model, channel removal can introduce inference-time memory copies.

arxiv-2312-01639.title: On the Effectiveness of Large Language Models in Domain-Specific Code Generation Conference: Conference on Software Engineering; May 2024;
arxiv-2312-01639.creator: Xiaodong Gu, Meng Chen, Yalan Lin, Yuhan Hu, Hongyu Zhang, Chengcheng Wan, Zhao Wei, Yong Xu, Juhong Wang
arxiv-2312-01639.description: Abstract . Large language models (LLMs) such as ChatGPT have shown remarkable capabilities in code generation. Despite significant achievements, they rely on enormous training data to acquire a broad spectrum of open-domain knowledge. Besides, their evaluation revolves around open-domain benchmarks like HumanEval, which primarily consist of programming contests.

arxiv-2504-10263.title: Quantized Axial Charge in the Hamiltonian Approach to Wilson Fermions
arxiv-2504-10263.creator: Tatsuya Yamaoka
arxiv-2504-10263.description: Abstract We investigate the Hamiltonian formulation of 1+1 D staggered fermions and reconstruct vector and axial charge operators, found by Arkya Chatterjee et al., using the Wilson fermion formalism. These operators commute with the Hamiltonian and become the generators of vector and axial U ⁡ ( 1 ) \mathrm{U}(1) symmetries in the continuum limit.

arxiv-2511-05151.title: The Geometry of Paraxial Vector Beams
arxiv-2511-05151.creator: Marco Ornigotti
arxiv-2511-05151.description: Abstract This work unveils a novel and fundamental connection between structured light and topological field theory by showing how the natural geometrical setting for paraxial vector beams is that of a S ​ U ​ ( 2 ) SU(2) principal bundle over ℝ 2 + 1 \mathbb{R}^{2+1} .

arxiv-2602-07741.title: Twisted Pseudodisk and Asymmetric Mass Accretion on the Circumstellar Disk
arxiv-2602-07741.creator: Masahiro N. Machida, Shantanu Basu, Shingo Hirano
arxiv-2602-07741.description: Abstract We model gas inflow patterns onto circumstellar disks and the evolution of the pseudodisk using three-dimensional resistive MHD simulations. Starting from a prestellar core without turbulence and with a misalignment between the initial magnetic field and rotation axis, the simulations are performed for ∼ 10 5 \sim 10^{5} yr after protostar formation.

pmc-11525329.title: The effect of laparoscopic vertical sleeve gastrectomy and laparoscopic roux-en-Y gastric bypass on gastroesophageal reflux disease: An updated meta-analysis and systematic review of 5-year post-operative data from randomized controlled trials
pmc-11525329.creator: Muhammed Ashraf Memon, Emma Osland, Rossita Mohamad Yunus, Zahirul Hoque, Khorshed Alam, Shahjahan Khan
pmc-11525329.description: BackgroundTo evaluate 5-year effect of laparoscopic vertical sleeve gastrectomy (LVSG) versus laparoscopic roux-en-Y gastric bypass (LRYGB) on gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD) solely based on randomized controlled trials (RCTs).MethodsA systematic review and meta-analysis of 5-year postoperative GERD data comparing LVSG and LRYGB in adults were undertaken. pmc-11646613.title: Establishing Correlates of Maternal-Fetal Cytomegalovirus Transmission—One Step Closer Through Predictive Modeling
pmc-11646613.creator: Arnaud Marchant, Sancar Adali, Hannah Alsdurf, Vanesa Bol, Xavier Capelle, Nathalie De Schrevel, Jean-Marc Delroisse, Roland Devlieger, Ilse Dieussaert, Catherine Donner, Michel Janssens, Philip Loquet, Anil A Panackal, Claudia Seidl, Robert A van den Berg, Robert Paris
pmc-11646613.description: BackgroundDeterminants of maternal-fetal cytomegalovirus (CMV) transmission and factors influencing the severity of congenital CMV (cCMV) infection are not well understood.MethodsWe conducted a descriptive, multicenter study in pregnant women ≥18 years old with primary CMV infection and their newborns to explore maternal immune responses to CMV and determine potential immunologic/virologic correlates of cCMV following primary infection during pregnancy.
